capabilities: (Add photos from vault or web link). (Customize photo appearance with frames and filters). (Animate photos by flipping and rotating). (Decorate photos with tapes, pins, and text). (Control photo positioning by locking to screen or document).
disambiguation: Not a note content editor; it is a visual overlay tool for the editor surface.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin (for desktop only) that adds sticky and floating photos on top of the editor
problem: Users lack a way to place persistent, customizable visual elements like photos directly onto the editor surface or anchored to specific notes.
summary: A desktop-only plugin that allows users to place and customize floating or sticky photos over the Obsidian editor, complete with frames, sounds, and decorations.
